infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Face ID unlocks your connection notebook and confirms pairing.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: The camera is used to scan your partner's pairing QR code and to take photos for your notes.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose photos from your library to attach to a note. Attachments are encrypted on your device before they ever leave it.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Record a voice note. Recordings are encrypted on your device before they ever leave it.
infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: The local network is used only to reach a sync server running on your Wi-Fi while testing the app.
